user_query: I am planning a surprise party for my friend's birthday. Can you suggest some interesting birthday messages and provide me with the list of existing webhooks? Also, check my account balance and retrieve the history of message replies to ensure everything goes smoothly.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of interesting birthday messages that can be used for the party.
Get the list of existing webhooks available for use.
Check the current account balance to ensure adequate funds for the party preparations.
Retrieve the history of message replies to ensure all communications are tracked.
